description: Golden routing evaluation for the omnicli catalog. Each case is a natural-language intent an agent would actually receive. `top1` is the skill that must win outright; `expect` must appear in the top 3; `expect_not` must NOT win (it is the hijack assertion); `min_margin` additionally requires the winner to beat the forbidden skill by that factor. Cases marked `drift` rely on curated aliases bridging a vocabulary gap (e.g. 'podcast' -> audio tooling); cases marked `prose` rely on the documentation body.

cases.query: turn a recorded podcast into readable text
cases.note: The original failure: 'podcast' appears in no audiocpp doc, only in the curated alias list. icm-architect is the historical hijacker and must lose by a clear margin.
